title: TimeHistoryLoadcase
description: TimeHistoryLoadcase: Defines a time history analysis case with time integration parameters.

Name.description: Unique name identifying the time history load case.

Number.description: Numerical identifier for the load case.

StartTime.description: Start time of the time history loadcase. Property has a quantity of type Time measured in [s].

EndTime.description: End time of the time history loadcase. Property has a quantity of type Time measured in [s].

TimeStep.description: Time step used for the loadcase.

_bhomVersion.description: Optional version of BHoM used as part of automatic versioning and schema upgrades.
